headline: Mortgage pressure grows as interest rates hit a 15-year high: Melbourne Nepalis feel the squeeze
summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia lifted interest rates to 4.6 per cent, their highest level in 15 years. It is the fourth rate rise of 2026, squeezing household mortgage budgets.
why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate that anchors domestic borrowing costs and influences the Australian dollar and bond yields. Rate moves directly affect mortgage holders and the housing market.
why_moved: A fourth rate rise of 2026 lifts the cash rate to its highest level in 15 years, raising borrowing costs.
